request_templates.purpose: Prove Cutter public library, search, transcript detail, reviewed auth, and cache remain compatible with the staged Admin Docker candidate.
Prove Cutter can still create and complete a real public-library cut after the staged Admin Docker candidate.
Optional UI smoke evidence for the staged Cutter desktop state.

preflight: Confirm the staged Admin Docker candidate is already deployed to the staging target and live-readonly/parity probes are rerun before starting these Cutter checks.
start_runs:

curl --noproxy '*' -sS -X POST 'http://192.168.1.20:3799/runs' -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-raw '{"suite":"windows_acceptance","options":{"auth_headers":{"device_id":"<approved-cutter-device-id>","session_token":"<approved-cutter-session-token>"}}}'

gates.title: Staged Cutter proof plan has no runtime side effects
gates.evidence: This report only writes a local plan artifact; it does not contact Windows Runner, Docker, NAS, Admin API, or Cutter API.

gates.title: Staged candidate image tag is explicit
gates.required_evidence: Set MIXLAB_DOCKER_TARGET_IMAGE_TAG or provide the candidate image tag from the accepted Admin Docker smoke artifact.

gates.title: Windows Runner URL is Mac-reachable
gates.required_evidence: Use the Windows LAN address from the environment registry, not Mac localhost.

gates.title: Expected ready count is positive
gates.required_evidence: MVP compatibility proof must assert the current ready baseline.

gates.title: Expected release/index version is explicit
gates.required_evidence: MVP v0.1 must prove Cutter release/index did not drift.

gates.title: Required Windows Runner suites are planned
gates.required_evidence: Plan must include both windows_acceptance and real_cut_smoke.

gates.title: Auth values are not recorded in the plan
gates.evidence: Request templates contain placeholders for approved Cutter auth headers only.

gates.title: Final compatibility proof command is prepared
gates.required_evidence: Plan must end with the existing proof validator.
